title: Item:Lorinda's Ultimate Remover
wikitext:
{{History|replaced={{Item|Dissolver}}}} {{Ingredient |icon = Lorinda's Ultimate Remover icon.png |pic = Lorinda's Ultimate Remover.png |type = raw |cost = 2 pp |weight = 0 |bind = {{Bind|No}} |system = Cannith |dropsfrom = |createdfrom = |usedin = [[Cannith Crafting]] |maxstack = 100 |description = This bubbling, green concoction is used in crafting deconstruction recipes to dissolve 'suffix' effects off of items and reduce them to their base magical essences.
'Suffix' effects are those that are listed after the main title of the object. Example: A Dagger of Deception has 'Deception' as its 'suffix' effect.
You can purchase Lorinda's Ultimate Remover at a crafting vendor or the in-game store. |tips = [[File:Lorinda's Ultimate Remover store.png|right]] * Purchased in stacks of 10 and can be stored in the [[Shared Crafting Storage]] *'''Note:''' You cannot buy just one of these, you must buy a stack of 10. }} ==See also== * [[DDOstore/Crafting#Cannith Crafting|Cannith Crafting items in the DDO Store]] [[Category:DDO Store items]] [[Category:Cannith Crafting]]
